assumptions: Conditional on playing with the recent receiving role.
Last seven reported regular-season games; recency weight is 0.8 per older game.
Counts use a negative-binomial predictive distribution; receiving yards use a positive lognormal predictive distribution.
Sampling uncertainty is inflated by 1 + 1/effective sample size.
No unsourced opponent, injury, or morale adjustment is applied.
Verified pregame forecast errors update the mean with 20 prior observations and a 20% correction cap.
